 Print Bihar SLET dummy admit card 2026 to be released today The Bihar School Examination Board ( BSEB ) will release the dummy admit card for the School Librarian Eligibility Test (SLET) 2026 today, November 2. Candidates appearing for the examination will be able to download their dummy admit cards from the official website at sletregistration.cbrt.co.in. Candidates will also get an opportunity to check and correct the details mentioned on their dummy admit cards. The correction window will remain open until November 5. Applicants should carefully verify all the information and make necessary changes within the given deadline. To download the Bihar SLET dummy admit card 2026, candidates will have to log in using their user ID and password. The dummy admit card will contain details such as the candidate's name, roll number, registration number, parents' names, photograph, signature and reserved category. Bihar SLET dummy admit card 2026: How to download?
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their Bihar SLET 2026 dummy admit card: Visit the official website, sletregistration.cbrt.co.in.
 Log in using your user ID and password.
 Check the Bihar SLET dummy admit card 2026 link.
 Download the dummy admit card.
 Check all the details mentioned on it.
 Make corrections, if required, and submit the changes.
 Download and save the confirmation page for future reference.
 Bihar SLET 2026 exam pattern
 The Bihar School Librarian Eligibility Test 2026 will be conducted in computer-based test (CBT) mode. The examination will have 150 multiple-choice questions (MCQs), carrying a total of 150 marks. There will be no negative marking in the examination. Candidates should check their dummy admit cards carefully and complete any required corrections before November 5.
